_readme: Add a company by appending an object to `companies`. `cebeTicker` = ticker used by https://cebetracker.io/api/v1/companies.json (balance-sheet source). `quote` = Yahoo Finance symbol for the stock price used in market cap and mNAV (e.g. MSTR, ASST, 3350.T). `currency` = currency of that quote; non-USD quotes are converted with Yahoo FX (e.g. JPY=X). `display_quote` = optional Yahoo symbol shown in the Stock price cell (e.g. MPJPY). It does not change market cap, mNAV, or residual NAV. The cell also shows `quote`'s latest regular-session close. If `display_quote` fails, the cell shows `quote` and a note. `manual` = optional overrides used when the CEBE feed lacks a company or you want to pin a value from a filing (btc_holdings, debt_usd, preferred_usd, cash_usd, strc_holdings_usd, basic_shares, diluted_shares, source, as_of). Manual values WIN over the feed, so remove them once stale. `filings` = optional freshness check. Figures stay on the CEBE/manual values. `filings.source` `sec` with `filings.cik` (10-digit CIK) records the latest 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-Q/A, 10-K, or 10-K/A from EDGAR. Optional `filings.ticker` overrides `ticker` when the EDGAR symbol differs. A legacy `sec_cik` (and optional `sec_ticker`) still selects the SEC check. `filings.source` `metaplanet` (or `tdnet`) reads Metaplanet's TDnet disclosure list at `filings.url`, default https://metaplanet.jp/en/shareholders/disclosures. Metaplanet does not file with the SEC.

manual.diluted_shares_source: Strive 8-K filed 2026-10-19 (as of 2026-10-16), Assumed Fully Diluted Shares: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1920406/000162828026066222/asst-20261019.htm
